cards.name: Summer Camps
cards.description: Campers participate in learning activities led by museum staff with assistance from youth volunteers.

hours.text: Drop-off no earlier than 8:45am; pickup no later than 4:15pm.

extended_care.cost_text: $75 per week, per session (morning or afternoon). Late pickups after 4:30pm are charged $50 per day.

lunch.text: Campers are required to bring a non-perishable lunch to camp every day. Lunches are available for purchase from Black Bear Coffee at an additional cost of $50 for the entire week, payable at the time of registration. Snacks and drinks are provided in all camps.
